ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERCONSENT_CRM
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent AS (
	SELECT 
		 BCM.ORGKEY AS [CustomerId]
		,BCM.STRTEXT13 AS [ConsentId]
		,BCM.DTDATE2 AS [PeriodStartDate]
		,NULL AS [PeriodEndDate]
		,NULL AS [ProofOfConsentDocumentId]
		,NULL AS [CustomerConsentNote]
		,BCM.STRTEXT11 AS [NoticeTypeId]
		,BCM.STRTEXT12 AS [NoticeSharingModeId]
		,'CRM' AS [SourceCode]
		,BCM.BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
		,0 AS [WorkFlowId]
		,0 AS [TaskRunId]
		,BCM.INSERT_DTTM AS [InsertDttm]
		,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA BCMD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM
	ON 	BCMD.MISCELLANEOUSID = BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID AND BCMD.BANK_ID = BCM.BANK_ID AND BCM.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE BCM.TYPE = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE'

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_SRC AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, ConsentId, PeriodStartDate, NoticeTypeId, NoticeSharingModeId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, ConsentId, PeriodStartDate, NoticeTypeId, NoticeSharingModeId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerConsent
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerConsent TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL


---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerConsent (
	[CustomerId]
	,[ConsentId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[ProofOfConsentDocumentId]
	,[CustomerConsentNote]
	,[NoticeTypeId]
	,[NoticeSharingModeId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.ConsentId AS ConsentId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS ProofOfConsentDocumentId
	,NULL AS CustomerConsentNote
	,SRC.NoticeTypeId AS NoticeTypeId
	,SRC.NoticeSharingModeId AS NoticeSharingModeId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerConsent (
	[CustomerId]
	,[ConsentId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[ProofOfConsentDocumentId]
	,[CustomerConsentNote]
	,[NoticeTypeId]
	,[NoticeSharingModeId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,ConsentId AS ConsentId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS ProofOfConsentDocumentId
	,NULL AS CustomerConsentNote
	,NoticeTypeId AS NoticeTypeId
	,NoticeSharingModeId AS NoticeSharingModeId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');
	

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA;	
	
	
END
